notable_updates.headline: Agility Robotics plans to go public via SPAC in a $2.5B deal
notable_updates.summary: Agility Robotics, maker of the bipedal warehouse robot Digit, agreed to merge with SPAC Churchill Capital Corp XI at a roughly $2.5 billion valuation, in a deal expected to generate over $620 million in proceeds.
